steps: Identify which formula to use (speed, density, or pressure)
Check units are consistent — convert if needed
Cover the unknown in the triangle to see the calculation
Give your answer with correct units
method_card.title: How to Use Speed, Density & Pressure Formulae
method_card.content:
Three compound measures follow the same pattern: quantity = something ÷ something.

Speed: \(S = \frac{D}{T}\), Distance = Speed × Time, Time = Distance ÷ Speed.

Density: \(D = \frac{M}{V}\), Mass = Density × Volume, Volume = Mass ÷ Density.

Pressure: \(P = \frac{F}{A}\), Force = Pressure × Area, Area = Force ÷ Pressure.

Use the formula triangle: cover the quantity you want to find. Whatever is left shows you the calculation. Always check units are consistent (e.g. convert minutes to hours for km/h).
method_card.example:
A block has mass 450 g and volume 50 cm³. Find its density.

Density = Mass ÷ Volume = 450 ÷ 50 = 9 g/cm³

gold.display: A train travels 180 km at 90 km/h, then 120 km at 60 km/h. Find the average speed for the whole journey.

misconceptions.message: Time 1 = 2 h, Time 2 = 2 h. Total = 300 km in 4 h. Average = 75 km/h. Don't average the speeds.

A car passes point A at 12:15 and point B (60 km away) at 13:00. Find the average speed.
An object exerts 500 N on the ground. Doubling the contact area would change the pressure by what factor?

misconceptions.message: P = F/A. If A doubles, P halves. Factor = ½.

silver.display: A car travels 90 km in 1 hour 30 minutes. Find the speed in km/h.

misconceptions.message: Convert: 1 h 30 min = 1.5 hours. Speed = 90 ÷ 1.5 = 60 km/h.

silver.display: A runner covers 400 m in 50 seconds. Find the speed in m/s.
A metal cube has sides 5 cm and mass 750 g. Find the density.

misconceptions.message: km/h to m/s: divide by 3.6. 72 ÷ 3.6 = 20 m/s. Or: 72000 m ÷ 3600 s = 20 m/s.

silver.display: A woman weighing 600 N stands on one foot with area 0.02 m². Find the pressure.
A car travels at 50 mph for 2 hours 24 minutes. How far does it go?
An alloy is made by mixing 300 g of metal A (density 10 g/cm³) with 400 g of metal B (density 8 g/cm³). Find the total volume.

misconceptions.message: Vol A = 300 ÷ 10 = 30 cm³. Vol B = 400 ÷ 8 = 50 cm³. Total = 80 cm³.
